camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi CreateHybridCloudCluster --region cn-hangzhou --HttpsPorts '443,8443' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --ProtectionServerCount 1 --ClusterName test --AccessMode internet --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HttpPorts '80,8080'
description_en: Creates a hybrid cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-hybrid-cloud-cluster --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --cluster-name test --http-ports 80,8080 --https-ports 443,8443 --access-mode internet --protection-server-count 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHybridCloudCluster

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The listening ports for the HTTP protocol. Separate multiple ports with commas (,), such as port1,port2,port3
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: http_ports

parameters.help_en: The listening ports for the HTTPS protocol. Separate multiple ports with commas (,), such as port1,port2,port3
parameters.help_zh: HTTPS协议的可用端口列表。 取值为字符串， 多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: https_ports

parameters.help_en:
The network access mode of the cluster. Valid values:

internet: access over the Internet.

vpc: access over an Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh:
网络接入模式。取值范围如下：
internet：公网接入。
vpc：专线私网接入
parameters.name: access_mode

parameters.help_en:
The region for Express Connect circuit access. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Hangzhou.

cn-beijing: Beijing.

cn-shanghai: Shanghai
parameters.help_zh:
专线接入区域。取值范围如下：
cn-hangzhou : 杭州。
cn-beiijng : 北京。
cn-shanghai : 上海
parameters.name: access_region

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. It no longer returns meaningful data
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已弃用，不再返回有意义的数据
parameters.name: log_fields_not_returned

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of protection nodes that can be added to the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群可添加的防护节点数量
parameters.name: protection_server_count

parameters.help_en: The description of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The type of the hybrid cloud cluster. Valid values:

cname: reverse proxy cluster. Traffic is forwarded through CNAME resolution.

service: transparent proxy cluster. Traffic is forwarded at the service level
parameters.help_zh:
集群类型。取值范围如下：
cname：反代集群。
service：服务化集群
parameters.name: proxy_type

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether manual bypass is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

on: Manual bypass is enabled.

off: Manual bypass is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
手动Bypass状态。取值范围如下：
on：开启。
off ：关闭
parameters.name: rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the bypass rule. Valid values:

bypass: skips WAF security checks and allows traffic to pass through directly
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值范围如下：
bypass ：不做安全检查，直接放行
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the bypass rule, in JSON format. This includes settings such as circuit breaker thresholds, request body size limits, and timeout values
parameters.name: rule_config

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the proxy gateway is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

on: The proxy gateway is enabled.

off: The proxy gateway is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
代理网关模式。取值范围如下：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: proxy_status

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：
cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster
